why_not_test: TEST partition contains zero Infiltration samples (Feature 7-9 finding); VALIDATION is the mixed-class development/evaluation partition used by Features 11/13.

attribution_methods.layer_c: Exact linear-model logit decomposition (LogisticRegression coef * value) for the classifier's prediction on the LSTM-predicted next state.
attribution_methods.layer_d_per_timestep: Whole-timestep occlusion (replace with TRAIN-mean baseline), measuring change in P(Infiltration).
attribution_methods.layer_d_per_cell: Per-(timestep,feature) occlusion, same baseline/measurement, computed only for the deterministic sample (expensive: 680 forward passes/sequence).

occlusion_baseline: TRAIN-set mean state vector per feature dimension (computed once from data/processed/splits/train/X_sequences_scaled.npy).
